items.content:
## 项目介绍

[awesome-openclaw](https://github.com/ZeroLu/awesome-openclaw) 是一个精选的 OpenClaw 教程、技能和使用案例集合。

## 为什么推荐

OpenClaw 是一个开源的 AI 助理框架，可以在本地运行，支持多种 LLM 提供商、可扩展技能和跨平台消息通道。

这个仓库整理了：

1. **安装方式对比** - 官方安装、EasyClaw 一键安装、腾讯云管家、阿里云无影、秒答等
2. **5400+ 技能列表** - 按类别整理（AI编程、浏览器自动化、搜索研究、效率工具等）
3. **5 个技能包一键安装提示词** - 超级助理、内容创作者、股票分析师、出海运营官、电商运营
4. **真实用例** - 内容消费、内容创作、效率提升、自动化等

## 相关链接

- GitHub: https://github.com/ZeroLu/awesome-openclaw
- OpenClaw 官网: https://openclaw.ai

适合想要搭建个人 AI 助理的开发者和初学者参考。

items.content:
【开源自荐】Flux Monitor - 专为作为服务器运行的 Mac 设计的监控与管理面板

开源地址：https://github.com/chentao1006/FluxMonitor

项目简介：
一款专为**作为服务器运行的 Mac** 设计的监控与服务管理面板。

![Screenshot 1](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chentao1006/FluxMonitor/main/screenshots/iScreen%20Shoter%20-%20Safari%E6%B5%8F%E8%A7%88%E5%99%A8%20-%20260311163944.jpg)

### 功能

- **系统概览**: 显示 CPU、内存、磁盘使用率及网络流量，运行终端命令。
- **进程管理**: 展示运行进程及其资源消耗。
- **日志分析**: 查看系统日志。
- **配置文件管理**: 编辑并管理系统配置文件。
- **自启服务管理**: 管理 macOS 的 LaunchAgents 与 LaunchDaemons 服务。
- **Docker**: 管理容器与镜像。
- **Nginx**: 管理站点及全局配置。
- **OpenClaw**: 查看进程及内存统计信息。
- **选配 AI 助手**: 绑定 OpenAI API 密钥后，可使用日志诊断、参数配置审查及故障排查辅助功能。

items.title: 【工具自荐】Skills Manager - AI 技能管理器
items.author: jiweiyeah
items.summary: Skills Manager (AI 技能管理器) 一款用于管理 AI 编程助手技能（Skills）的统一桌面应用。 无缝组织、同步和共享 Claude Code、Codex、Opencode、Openclaw 及其他 AI 工具的技能。 📖 简介 Skills Manager 是一款现代化的桌面应用程序，旨在解决 AI 助手的 Skills 配置碎片化的问题。它提供了一个中心化的枢纽，让您不再需要为不同的工具分别管理 Skills 技能。 通过强大的软链接同步机制（Symlink Synchronization），您只需编写一次技能，即可在 Claude Code、Codex、Opencode 等支持的 AI 工具中即时生效，实现"一处编写，多处使用"。 ✨ 核心功能 🎯 统一管理：在一个安全的位置集中管理所有的 AI Skills。 🔄 智能同步：自动化的软链接管理，确保您的工具始终使用最新版本的技能，无需手动复制文件。 🎛️ 灵活控制：无需删除源文件，即可随时针对特定工具启用或禁用某个 Skill。 ⚡ 极致性能：基于 Rust 和 Tauri 2.0 构建，带来轻量级、秒开的极致体验。 🛡️ 跨平台支持：完美支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 系统。 🔌 多工具支持：开箱即用支持 Claude Code、Codex、Opencode等常用工具，并具备良好的扩展性。 🧩 自定义工具：支持用户添加自定义工具，配置路径与图标。 🎨 现代 UI：基于 React 19、Tailwind CSS v4 和 Radix UI 打造的精美界面。 📸 应用截图

items.title: [开源推荐] MindVault — Agent 驱动的可治理知识系统
items.author: Guyungy
items.summary: 项目地址 类别 人工智能 项目标题 Agent 驱动的可追溯、可治理、可持续演化的知识系统 项目描述 MindVault 是一个 Agent 驱动的 AI 知识系统：它把聊天、文档、表格等多源碎片信息先抽象为带证据链的 claims（含来源引用与置信度），再合并为 Canonical Knowledge Base。与一次性抽取不同，它强调可追溯与治理：冲突识别、缺失字段占位符、Schema 演化候选、版本快照与变更记录，让知识可以长期积累、持续更新并可审计回放。 亮点 以 claims 作为中间层：保留 provenance + confidence，方便冲突处理与逐步合并 治理输出（conflict / placeholder / schema candidates）是一等公民，适合长期运营的知识资产 每次运行生成 snapshot + changelog，支持追踪知识随时间的演化过程 同时提供人类可读的报告/Dashboard，降低落地门槛 示例代码 bash python3 m mindvault.runtime.app w workspace i sampledata/benchmarks/semistructured.json 截图或演示视频
items.content: ### 项目地址 https://github.com/Guyungy/MindVault ### 类别 人工智能 ### 项目标题 Agent 驱动的可追溯、可治理、可持续演化的知识系统 ### 项目描述 MindVault 是一个 Agent 驱动的 AI 知识系统：它把聊天、文档、表格等多源碎片信息先抽象为带证据链的 claims（含来源引用与置信度），再合并为 Canonical Knowledge Base。与一次性抽取不同，它强调可追溯与治理：冲突识别、缺失字段占位符、Schema 演化候选、版本快照与变更记录，让知识可以长期积累、持续更新并可审计回放。 ### 亮点 - 以 claims 作为中间层：保留 provenance + confidence，方便冲突处理与逐步合并 - 治理输出（conflict / placeholder / schema candidates）是一等公民，适合长期运营的知识资产 - 每次运行生成 snapshot + changelog，支持追踪知识随时间的演化过程 - 同时提供人类可读的报告/Dashboard，降低落地门槛 ### 示例代码 ```bash python3 -m mindvault.runtime.app -w workspace -i sample_data/benchmarks/semi_structured.json ``` ### 截图或演示视频

items.title: HRVSpark
items.summary: Your HRV. Raw. Beautiful. On your wrist.
items.content: The usual HRV app flow: data → algorithm → verdict → user. HRVSpark reverses it: data → user → intuition. Raw SDNN sparklines and gauges on your Apple Watch face, across four time windows. Complication-first — always visible, never buried in an app. Works alongside analysis suites like Athlytic or HRV4Training, or stands alone as your only HRV tool. $2.99 one-time. No subscription. No account.

items.summary: Actionable intelligence for consumer-sector investors
items.content: Reldro is a B2C investment intelligence platform for PE firms, investment banks, and venture firms focused on consumer-sector deal flow and insights. It combines proprietary research, live deal flow, alternative data, sentiment analysis, and AI-powered insights across 12k+ public and private consumer companies. New features include the Helix Score, a momentum index for comparing companies, and an AI Analyst for instant data-driven analysis.

items.title: StreamerUtility
items.summary: Polished stream overlays, no janky ad-covered websites
items.content: Tired of streamers Googling janky ad-covered spin wheel sites mid-stream? StreamerUtility is a clean dashboard with 16 (and growing) interactive overlays – 3D dice and coin flip, spin wheel, lootbox, timers and counters, bingo, soundboard and more. Control from a second monitor or your phone, viewers see polished animations live on stream. No installs – just paste a URL into OBS. Works alongside StreamLabs/StreamElements. Free tier available, Pro is $36/year.

items.title: Backlog Shuffle
items.summary: Burn through your gaming backlog with AI
items.content: Don't let "choice paralysis" keep you from your hobby. Backlog Shuffle uses AI to bridge the gap between your gaming library and your life. Whether you have 20 minutes or a whole Sunday, we match your current mood and available time to the perfect game. Let us do the guesswork. You just hit Start.

items.title: youraislopboresme
items.summary: Your AI Slop Bores Me
items.content: The phrase that launched a thousand memes — and a whole movement against AI slop. - 🔥 **260,000 visits in 24 hours** - 📰 Hacker News Show HN Hot Topics - 🌐 A landmark product that sparked discussions about AI Slop culture - 📈 The emergence of copycat websites demonstrates the influence.

items.title: Realm of Idle Hunts
items.summary: Pixel-art idle RPG with auto-hunt, bosses, and loot
items.content: Realm of Idle Hunts is a pixel-art idle RPG where your hero auto-hunts mobs, unlocks bestiary and museum perks, defeats bosses, and evolves through gear, skills, and progression systems.

items.title: Sturdyfin
items.summary: Know your Financial Stability Score in 3 minutes
items.content: SturdyFin helps people understand their financial stability in a simple, structured way. In about three minutes, it analyzes key signals such as income stability, savings behavior, debt pressure, spending balance, and financial priorities to generate a Financial Stability Score. Users can explore what affects their score, simulate financial decisions, and track progress over time through a simple dashboard designed to improve long-term financial resilience.

items.title: Mutual Fund Portfolio Analyzer from CAS
items.summary: Instant mutual fund portfolio analysis -> from CAS statement
items.content: Analyze your mutual fund portfolio instantly using your CAS statement. Upload your CAS PDF and get a simple portfolio report showing XIRR, investment vs current value, fund allocation, and key insights. No login. No account linking. Privacy-first. A quick and easy way for investors to understand their mutual fund portfolio in seconds. Upload your CAS → Get your Mutual Fund Portfolio Health Report instantly.

items.title: Rise
items.summary: A Daily Planner for the Agentic Era.
items.content: Rise is a daily planner for the AI age. Each morning, plan your entire day in minutes using recurring activities that reflect how you actually spend your time. Rise integrates with Apple Calendar and syncs across devices via iCloud. Widgets, Live Activities, and a Mac menu bar timer keep your schedule visible, while local AI Operator helps you understand and navigate your day — all private by default.

items.title: iVenture
items.summary: iVenture - Connecting iGaming Startups with Investors
items.content: iVenture is a marketplace connecting iGaming startups, scale-ups, established companies, and individuals seeking exits with investment funds, venture capital firms, and solo investors.

items.title: OpenUI
items.summary: The open standard for Generative UI
items.content: The Open Standard for Generative UIMake your AI apps respond with interactive UI components like cards, tables, forms and charts instead of text. Streaming-native, token-efficient, and works with any AI model (GPT,Claude,M2.5) and agent framework like ai-sdk, Google ADK

items.title: ChoresMates
items.summary: Splitwise, but for household chores
items.content: ChoresMates gives every household chore a point value based on actual effort, so the numbers speak for themselves. Create a group, invite your household, add chores with point values (or pick from 100+ templates), and watch the real-time leaderboard settle the score. Features include chore scheduling and rotation, photo proof, emoji reactions, and home screen widgets. Available on iOS and Android. Free to use, with Pro for $0.99/mo or $19.99 lifetime.

items.title: SagitPods
items.summary: A podcast player values privacy and a clean experience.
items.content: Designed for listeners who value privacy, control, and a clean, customizable experience. Powerful & Customizable Playback Offline Mode Easy Backup & Restore (Currently, local storage first.) Personalize Your Theme

items.title: World Clue
items.summary: The ultimate test of your world knowledge.
items.content: World Clue is a daily geography game that takes the challenge to the next level. World Clue will test your country knowledge on several topics including culture, politics, economy and much more. This is a way to broaden your knowledge of the world in a fun and challenging way!

items.title: EnduMap V1
items.summary: Discover endurance races across India in one place
items.content: Discover marathons, trail runs, ultramarathons, triathlons and endurance events happening across India. Browse upcoming races, locations and registration links on EnduMap
